_why: Generated from the post-batch-fix tree, 2026-08-15. THE NUMBER MAY FALL FREELY AND MAY NOT RISE without a human editing this file in the same commit as the code, where a reviewer sees it. Raising an entry is a decision to ship a failure the caller cannot distinguish from a real empty answer. Read the fix ladder in tools/audit_swallow_sites.py first: propagate a typed error, or carry the failure in the return value, or (best-effort paths only) narrow the except and log at ERROR. A per-file count can also rise for an innocent reason -- splitting one `except (OSError, ValueError)` into a silent FileNotFoundError branch plus a logged one scores as TWO sites, because the tool counts returns inside handlers and cannot see log levels. Say which it is in the commit message. REBASED 2026-08-18: prospector/control_center/ was deleted. Two of its files moved to prospector/ops/ and carry their counts under the new path (readers.py 1, runner.py 1) — the same sites, not new ones. Nothing rose.
